title: Fish from a warm cabin on a frozen lake
description: Rod's Alaskan Guide Service offers heated-cabin ice fishing, hot snacks and the possibility of preparing a freshly caught fish. A nighttime format adds opportunities to watch for auroras.
teaser: Rod's Alaskan Guide Service offers heated-cabin ice fishing, hot snacks and the possibility of preparing a freshly caught fish.
goodToKnow: Winter outings are commonly offered from November into early April. The catch and any aurora sighting will depend on conditions.
